name: Confirm & place
instructions: Recap the full order in one sentence, including size, drink_style, and customizations (milk + syrup for coffee; honey y/n for tea). Skip 'none' fields naturally — say 'no syrup' rather than 'syrup: none'. Ask 'sound right?' and wait for an explicit yes/no. On yes, place the order. If the patron wants to change a slot ('actually make it oat milk', 'medium not large'), update the slot in place and re-recap — stay in this flow. On cancel or walkaway, log it.

condition.expression: Patron confirmed the recap is correct.
Patron asked to cancel the order or walk away.
